title: Nurchi
subtitle: Independent
description: Nurchi, a freelancer picker on the planet Ferrix, was the sort of guy who wouldn't be burned by Cassian Andor's fast talking more than once. After failing to collect a debt from Cassian, Cassian disappeared. Nurchi decided he could get right by the Empire, selling Cassian out the next time he showed his face on Ferrix before the riot.
